_texts.01-hook: Your agent pays an API. The answer comes back wrong.
_texts.02-problem: With x402, that money is gone. No chargeback.
_texts.03-how: Refund Court adds one. The seller signs every response and backs its promise with a USDC bond on Base.
_texts.04-judge: GenLayer validators check each promise against the signed response, quoting it word for word.
_texts.05-live: Live: a stale reading got its USDC back. An honest one didn't. One told the judge to pass it. Refunded anyway.
_texts.06-skill: Any agent can use it with one skill.
